name: D3DMetal behavioral parity comparison
goal: Compare all six domains without treating symbol presence or static inspection as global conformance proof.

nodes.task:
TASK: Compare D3DMetal and current DXMT for the API/device domain and return verified missing features or optimizations.
DELIVERABLE: A bounded report (<=3500 words) with a coverage table for these angles: feature reporting, SM/FL admission, Device14 methods, root-signature deserialization, Agility factory, lifetime/protected/meta commands, device removal, descriptor copies, allocation queries, query heap creation. For each mark existing, confirmed gap, reference unsupported, or unknown. Each confirmed gap MUST include D3DMetal decompiled behavior/offset/full Evidence ID, exact owned source counterpart/line, actual game-path relevance, minimal independent implementation recommendation and focused test command. Prefer genuinely missing work, not repeating existing 18/19 optimization ports.
SCOPE: Read repository src/d3d12/d3d12_device.cpp; src/d3d12/d3d12.cpp; src/d3d12/d3d12_sdk.cpp; src/d3d12/d3d12_interfaces_ext.hpp, neighboring headers/tests and canonical CORE/PRIORITIES docs as needed. Read REA shared target D3DMetal SHA256 f5b56df1b8fe8b364dd9530651a3769c8aed948bd343be3b4510604d503e2bad. DO NOT open, close, switch, or annotate the shared REA target. Read skill://reverse-engineer-anything/SKILL.md. Product files are read-only. No nested agents, no builds, no claims from names alone. Use tool.find for unknown owned implementation location, LSP for code intelligence. Function names differing is NOT absence.
VERIFY: Read the relevant owned function bodies and REA function bodies for every claimed gap. Existing source and docs establish much more than names suggest: consult CORE sections 'D3DMetal 비교 기반 최적화 이식' and 'SM6.6·FL12_2'. Source map: doc/mass-ulw/01a12b4e-5c2f-7295-ae4a-6c57909964fd/source-map.md. Inventory: doc/mass-ulw/01a12b4e-5c2f-7295-ae4a-6c57909964fd/reference-inventory.md is ONLY a discovery index; its unsupported full-surface claims are rejected. Prior raw REA: build/local/d3d12-gap-rea-20261010/coverage-final.json. Read previous evidence instead of repeating where useful. Query exact addresses if overloaded; request bounded result projections instead of dumping giant REA wrappers.
STOP WHEN: All ten angles have evidence-based dispositions and confirmed gaps or exact unknowns are returned. Do not return invented gaps to satisfy the task.
nodes.solutionSpace: Comparison requires function-level reasoning across proprietary static evidence and a mature independent implementation; default reasoning worker rather than mechanical scout.
nodes.verdict: Evidence report saved; confirmed gaps separated from unknowns and reference-unsupported paths.
